chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The owner of the provision drinks first among the people and performs wudu (ablution) last among them."

key_terms.الرَّحْلِ: the saddle, baggage, or travel provision
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this prophetic teaching
key_terms.صَاحِبُ: the one in charge or owner

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about drinking and wudu (ablution) etiquette during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper etiquette in shared travel or communal settings. It indicates that the one responsible for the riding gear or provision takes the first drink, while out of consideration for others he delays his wudu (ablution) until after them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4251 - The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"The owner of the provision will drink first among the people and performs ablution last among them."
